It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 2022.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 11, 2021 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} The district consists of municipalities in central Bulacan, namely [[Balagtas, Bulacan|Balagtas]], [[Bocaue, Bulacan|Bocaue]], [[Guiguinto]], and [[Pandi, Bulacan|Pandi]] and does not have any provincial boundaries. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Agay Cruz]] of the [[Partido Federal ng Pilipinas]] (PFP).{{cite web|url=https://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 26, 2023}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" colspan="2" |# ! colspan="2" |Member ! colspan="2" |Term of office ! rowspan="2" |Congress ! rowspan="2" |Party ! rowspan="2" |Electoral history ! rowspan="2" |Constituent
